title: どうぶつの森
sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness

The table: 100 codes, each read in play, the codes of a page beside what the screen showed; the kana's codes keep the order of the fifty sounds in stretches. Digits and signs are ASCII. No font was read
Played from power-on through the opening on the stage, the train (with a telephone call) and the arrival at the station: the route replayed from power-on in one run with the script loaded

What the script said agreed with the rows read off 31 of 31 pictures, over 4 scenes; it said nothing on the 4 screens without text. 19 more pages were snapped, but their pictures came out black and weren't compared
The same readings built the table, so the comparison checks pages and their order more than the characters
notes: Read by the script games/n64/NUS-NAFJ.lua: a speech bubble's page once it has typed out and waits (or puts a choice or the keyboard up, or ends the message). Not read: who speaks, a choice's answers and cursor, the name and letter screens. Codes not met in play come out as U+FFFD.
